meta.name: add-vercel
meta.description: Add Vercel deployment capability to NanoClaw agents. Installs the Vercel CLI in agent containers and sets up OneCLI credential injection for api.vercel.com. Use when the user wants agents to deploy web applications to Vercel.

copy.tagline: 让智能体把网站部署到 Vercel
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想用智能体自动部署网站到 Vercel
copy.tagline_en: Let your agent deploy websites to Vercel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to automatically deploy websites to Vercel

howto.what: 它会为 NanoClaw agent 安装 Vercel CLI,并配置 OneCLI 自动注入 Vercel 凭据,之后 agent 就能把 Web 应用部署到 Vercel。安装后会同步到已有的 agent 组并重启容器。
howto.when: 当你希望 agent 能把 Web 应用部署到 Vercel 时触发。若 OneCLI 未安装,需先运行 /init-onecli 再重试。

say.text: 帮我把这个项目部署到 Vercel 生产环境
列出我在 Vercel 上的所有部署
查一下当前的 Vercel 登录身份

howto.what_en: It installs the Vercel CLI in NanoClaw agent containers and configures OneCLI to inject Vercel credentials, so agents can deploy web applications to Vercel.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want agents to deploy web applications to Vercel. If OneCLI is missing, run /init-onecli first, then retry.

say_en.text: Deploy this project to Vercel production
Check which Vercel account I'm logged in as
